story.title: The first weight
story.intro: You wake beneath a broken calibration ring. The machines call you an error. When you move, the dust chooses a new direction.
story.memory: Memory 01: We did not give the core gravity. We taught it to remember where things belonged.

secret.name: The maintenance passage
secret.text: Behind the foundry seal, a worker left a calibration mark: every locked door has a direction in which it is already open.

story.title: A language in the crystal
story.intro: Every crystal repeats the same mechanical pulse. The caverns were grown around a signal older than the facility.
story.memory: Memory 02: The first civilization built no roads. It changed where falling ended.

secret.name: The first resonance
secret.text: A crystal preserves an argument between two architects. One wanted a perfect center. The other wanted every traveler to carry one.

story.title: The manufactured horizon
story.intro: The planet is hollow. Under its dead surface, damaged engines still pull toward a center that no longer exists.
story.memory: Memory 03: A world is a promise between its matter. Break the promise, and the pieces keep searching.

secret.name: Weight of the survivors
secret.text: The dead planet’s vault lists no kings or weapons. Its last inventory counts shelters, gardens, and the mass required to keep them together.

story.title: The last station
story.intro: A silent station circles an absent sun. Its navigation records show thousands of artificial planets moving away from something.
story.memory: Memory 04: Evacuation was not an escape through space. We moved the space itself.

secret.name: An unsent course
secret.text: The station kept an evacuation route hidden from its own guardian. It leads toward the broken worlds, where the missing passengers chose to rebuild.

story.title: Inside the missing star
story.intro: Light bends around your core. Beyond the horizon, an old intelligence asks why you still believe that gravity must pull.
story.memory: Memory 05: A singularity is not a point. It is a decision that the universe refuses to undo.

secret.name: A horizon with a hinge
secret.text: Inside the singularity, the sealed archive has two exits occupying the same point. The old intelligence calls this its first act of mercy.

story.title: The unfinished experiment
story.intro: The laboratory holds copies of your first chamber. Each copy ends differently. One recording contains your voice.
story.memory: Memory 06: We made a mind that could choose its own center. Then we became afraid of what it might choose.

secret.name: Experiment zero
secret.text: Your earliest recording contains no orders. A researcher asks what you want to hold, then waits while you learn to answer.

story.title: The unbound gardens
story.intro: Islands drift without a planet beneath them. Life has learned to follow tiny, temporary centers instead of a single world.
story.memory: Memory 07: Freedom was never the absence of gravity. It was the right to change what held you.

secret.name: The gardener’s orbit
secret.text: The drifting islands are connected by seeds. Each carries enough gravity to find another patch of earth, and enough freedom to leave it.

story.title: The open frontier
story.intro: The final boundary is collapsing. You can restore its old center, or carry its fragments into a frontier that has no fixed shape.
story.memory: Memory 08: You are not the last Gravityborn. You are the first one who can leave.

secret.name: The unfinished map
secret.text: The vault contains a map with its final boundary erased. The Gravityborn who drew it expected a future traveler to choose what came next.

story.title: Homes between worlds
story.intro: Beyond the frontier, broken colony rings still circle the fragments they once sheltered. The Planet Eater follows their remaining gravity. The survivors ask you to hold a path open.
story.memory: Memory 09: The colonies never needed one perfect world. They needed someone to keep the pieces within reach.

secret.name: The shared center
secret.text: A schoolroom map names every moon after a family that returned. Its final lesson is written over the old evacuation order: a home is a place that makes room for another orbit.

planet.name: Concord Remnants
planet.property: Broken colonies around competing planetary fragments
